candidate.title: MARS-Seq
candidate.scope: Illumina schematic-level MARS-Seq library architecture, associated with Jaitin et al. (2014): the middle row from poly(A) RNA through UMI/T7-associated cDNA, RNA-fragment library construction and final P5/P7 cDNA. The full image also contains a separate upper Digital RNA/HiRes-Seq/FREQ-Seq/RNAtag-Seq row, a separate lower Quartz-Seq row and clipped right-hand chemistry; none is an alternative target of this MARS-Seq card. The row has one continuing route and no depicted compartment-pooling branch. T7 in vitro transcription is an explicitly literature-supported interpretation of an unlabeled interface, using the supplied full-text review; the original primary supplementary preparation text has not been verified. This is the depicted implementation, not a claim about all MARS-Seq versions.

method_scopes.rationale: All captioned operations in the explicitly headed MARS-Seq row belong to this target. The primer-addition block includes first-strand RT by the review-supported interpretation of the oligo(dT)/T7 interface. op_ivt is the review-supported, uncaptioned RNA-generation interface; its placement before op_dnase is inferred and marked as such. The figure's DNaseI caption and RNA-fragmentation route are preserved, without attributing RNA synthesis to DNaseI. The RNA-fragment population stays together at schematic scope; multiple fragment icons do not establish separate processing or a discard step. The primary main text supports single-cell sampling and three barcode levels, but the row explicitly labels only UMI and does not locate cell/plate tag addition. Applicability is resolved for this schematic architecture; exact promoter/transcribed-end structure and primary verification of the inserted local IVT position remain limited as recorded below.

unknowns.question: Can the original primary supplementary preparation schematic verify the local placement of op_ivt before the shown DNaseI arrow? The supplied primary main text b00006 delegates details to figures S1–S6 and supplementary methods; its text does not state this sequence. The supplied review explicitly establishes T7 IVT for MARS-Seq, so the DNA-to-RNA interface is resolved at architecture level, while this exact placement is an inference requiring primary supplementary evidence.

Which part of the drawn partialT7/T7-associated end belongs to the active DNA promoter versus the transcribed tagged RNA? Red/green blocks persist in the RNA-fragment and final-library cartoons, but the figure and inspected text do not define the exact boundary. A primary oligonucleotide/amplicon map is needed before interpreting the colored blocks as an exact promoter or read structure; this does not block the tag-linked transcript-fragment architecture.
